_about: Pre-port CLI behaviour of unwind-rc.sh on sandbox roots and repositories (scenarios), and the expected outcome of the scenarios whose behaviour changed on purpose (changed); see team/tests/integration/test_cm_unwind_rc.py. Scenarios for a project the shared push-decision resolver cannot resolve (no project.cfg, no dev_tree_path in it, a project directory with no project.cfg) are recorded with the push gate applied: one skipped-unresolved-project line and no origin check. Every scenario whose unwind renames the requirements file SUPERSEDED, or finds it already renamed, is recorded with that file's ## Status closed to wont-do (staged with the rename when the file is tracked).
